proofs.text: Build the payload for the same project at each of the three gates; verify the cell names are exactly `["passed"]`, `["passed", "strong"]` and `["passed", "strong", "signed"]`

rule_text: The strong cell exists only at the gate `strong` and above and the signed cell only at `signed`; a cell above the gate is absent from `cells` rather than present and empty

tests.name: test_a_cell_above_the_gate_is_absent
